look_here_first: Smooth green annual with slender terminal spikes, rounded or notched leaf tips, only three tepals, and a small indehiscent rugose fruit.

project_inclusion.range_basis: 1 wild iNaturalist observation; current Kew and FNA treat Texas occurrence as introduced.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for visual learning; only current native-range evidence should feed native metrics.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Amaranthaceae/Amaranthus: alternate petiolate leaves and dense clusters of tiny unisexual flowers. Habit, plant sex, hairiness, nodal spines, cluster position, bract/tepal form, and fruit dehiscence are high-value characters.
best_field_traits: leaf apex often rounded or emarginate
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Smoother and more slender than redroot pigweed; no nodal spines; thinner seedhead than most erect pigweeds.
